packageType.standard: Standard package · tests are generated on a judge

howTo.title: How-to for problem setters
howTo.readIsEnough: Read access is enough: QHHOJ changes nothing on Polygon. Treat the link like a password: anyone who has it and may import on QHHOJ can import the problem.

access.title: Give read access
access.body: On Polygon, open the problem, go to Manage access and add {account} with Read access.

package.title: Build a package
package.body: Commit your changes, go to Packages, click Create package (Full imports faster) and wait for READY.

paste.title: Paste the problem link
paste.body: Copy the link shaped like {shape}, not an address with ccid or session.

howTo.inPackage: Every package also records this link in its problem.xml (the url attribute of the problem tag).

check.hint: Calls Polygon once with the saved key and secret; save your changes before testing.
check.ok: Connected at {time}. Polygon accepts the key of {account}: {count} problems are shared with the account.

wizard.title: Import from Polygon
wizard.lead: Give {account} Read access on Polygon, paste the problem link, configure it, then follow the import.

link.label: Polygon problem link
link.hint: On Polygon, give {account} Read access to the problem, then paste the address of its page.
link.notLinked: Not linked to any QHHOJ problem yet.

slow.title: Downloading the package to verify the link
slow.body: A problem's first check downloads its whole package; a large one can take a few minutes. Keep this page open.

invalid.title: That is not a Polygon problem link
invalid.body: Paste the full address of the problem page: https://polygon.codeforces.com/p…/owner/name.

refused.title: This link cannot be opened by {account}
refused.body: Give {account} READ access on Polygon (Manage access), then copy the link again from the problem page.

noPackage.title: The problem has no package yet
noPackage.body: QHHOJ checks the link against a package of the problem. On Polygon, go to Packages, click Create package (Full imports faster), wait for READY, then check again.

notReady.title: No ready package to import
notReady.body: The newest package is not ready: it is still building or it failed. On Polygon, open Packages and build a full or standard package; if one is running, wait until it finishes.
notReady.FAILED: The newest package (r{revision}) failed on Polygon
notReady.RUNNING: The newest package (r{revision}) is still building
notReady.failedBody: Fix it on Polygon, build the package again, then check again.
notReady.failedNoComment: Open Packages on Polygon to see the error, fix it, build the package again, then check again.
notReady.runningBody: Wait until Polygon finishes (state READY), then check again.

linked.title: Already on QHHOJ
linked.withCode: This Polygon problem is linked to {code}. Open it and use Sync.
linked.hidden: This Polygon problem is already linked to a QHHOJ problem.

editing.title: This is an editing-session address
editing.body: Addresses with ccid, session or problemId only open while signed in. Paste the problem link shaped like {shape}.

checking.title: The problem's package is being downloaded for its first check
checking.auto: Another check is downloading the package. QHHOJ checks again in {wait}.
checking.manual: A large package can take a few minutes. Click Check again in a little while.

linkedDeleted.title: This Polygon problem is linked to the deleted problem {code}
linkedDeleted.titleHidden: This Polygon problem is linked to a deleted problem
linkedDeleted.body: Restore {code} and use Sync; or restore it and unlink {code} to import again. Once {code} is purged, the link is freed.
linkedDeleted.bodyHidden: That problem's managers can restore it and unlink it; once it is purged, the link is freed.

notConnected.title: Polygon is not connected
notConnected.bodyAdmin: The site has no Polygon API key or secret yet, so links cannot be checked. You can still import a .zip file.
notConnected.bodyAsk: The site has no Polygon API key yet. Ask an administrator to add one; meanwhile a .zip file still imports.

source.label: Source

taken.limits: Time and memory limits and partial scoring

source.kept: Code, points, group, types, authors, curators and allowed languages. Later syncs never overwrite these.

configure.title: Configure the import
configure.lead: Statements, tests and the checker come from the Polygon package; the rest are QHHOJ settings.
configure.autoSync: Sync automatically on a new package
configure.autoSyncHint: When a package newer than r{revision} is built, re-import statements, tests and the checker.
configure.autoSyncMore: Checked every 10 minutes; postponed while a contest using the problem is running.

languages.title: Statement languages from Polygon
languages.single: The package has one statement ({language}); it becomes the problem statement.
languages.tutorialHint: {count} statements have a tutorial on Polygon; pick one.
languages.tutorialOne: The editorial comes from the {language} statement.
languages.tutorialNone: No statement has a tutorial on Polygon.
languages.repeated: Another statement is already {site}: pick another language or Skip.

update.targetBody: {title}. Click Update to see what is replaced.
update.targetMissing: No problem {code} among the problems you can edit.

confirm.title: Overwrite {code} with the Polygon package?

items.tests: Tests and test groups → the tests of package r{revision}

confirm.kept: Kept: code, points, group, types, authors, curators, allowed languages (except the fields you fill in QHHOJ settings).
confirm.lost: Edits to the items above made on QHHOJ will be lost.

refusal.statement_language_unmapped: Pick a QHHOJ language or Skip for the {language} statement.
refusal.statement_language_repeated: Two statements are {language}: pick another language or Skip.
refusal.too_many_testcases: The problem has {count} tests, over your limit of {limit}.

progress.title: Import from Polygon
progress.lead: The package is processed in the background. You can leave; the import keeps running and stays in “My imports”.

unnamed.waiting: Asking for the state of the import

hint.running: You can leave; the import keeps running.
hint.generating: Generating tests usually takes 2 to 30 minutes.

lost.title: No state after several tries
lost.text: The page asked several times without an answer. The import keeps running on the server.

summary.title: What differs from Polygon
summary.interactive: Interactive: {checker}, run on what the interactor wrote
summary.checkerIgnored: The package checker is not run because the grader was kept as edited on QHHOJ
summary.kept: Kept as edited on QHHOJ · Polygon: {polygon}

panel.title: Polygon link

revisionText.notReady: The newest package on Polygon is not ready ({state}); it cannot be synced yet.
revisionText.unknown: Polygon cannot be asked right now: not connected, unreachable, or the account lost read access.

panel.readOnly: {needs} to sync, switch auto-sync or unlink.

syncConfirm.title: Sync {code} from Polygon?
syncConfirm.overwrites: The sync overwrites on QHHOJ: statements and translations, the tutorial, tests. Limits, partial scoring, checker and grader also come from the package, except those edited on QHHOJ since the last import: they are kept.
syncConfirm.lost: Edits to statements, the tutorial and tests on QHHOJ since the last import are lost; copy them to Polygon first if you need them.
syncConfirm.kept: Kept: code, points, group, types, authors, curators, allowed languages, Unicode, nobigmath, output limit and prefix.

overwriteLocal.label: Also overwrite settings edited on QHHOJ
overwriteLocal.consequence: Limits, partial scoring, checker, grader go back to the package.

unlinkConfirm.title: Unlink {code} from Polygon?
unlinkConfirm.body: The problem's content stays; only syncing stops (auto-sync too). To link again, import the problem in update mode.

saved.title: Options saved
saved.text: They apply from the next sync; the problem has not changed yet.

notReady.title: The newest package on Polygon is not ready

options.defaults: As the package has it, nothing chosen

drawer.title: Sync options
drawer.note: They apply from the next sync; the problem does not change now.
drawer.noLanguages: The saved options pick no statement: the package has one, and it is the main one.

history.title: Imports and syncs, newest first
history.empty: No import or sync has been recorded yet.

stale.title: The newest package is r{package}; Polygon is at r{revision}
stale.body: QHHOJ will import r{package}. To import the newer revision: commit, build a package, then check again.
stale.bodyModified: QHHOJ will import r{package}. The problem also has uncommitted changes. To import the newer revision: commit, build a package, then check again.

modified.title: The problem has uncommitted changes on Polygon
modified.body: QHHOJ will import package r{package}, without those changes. To import them: commit, build a package, then check again.

standard.title: Standard package: tests are generated on a judge
standard.body: The import can take many minutes and needs a running judge. A Full package imports faster.
